text:
maria: Quick sync — pen-test kickoff in 2w. We need a short ringdown plan for RBAC tweaks + KMS access windows. Who can own the ops side for evidence handoff?

nate: I can take ops lead for the window. Need clarity on which services get ephemeral roles vs read-only.

elaine: +1 nate. For readroom access: prefer ephemeral STS role scoped to kms:Decrypt and logs:Read.

alex: For KMS, the vendor only needs envelope decrypt for artifact verification. We should avoid granting raw key material access.

maria: Agreed. Proposal: ephem role that assumes for 6 hours, attached policy example below. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

maria: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/xxxx"
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:DescribeLogGroups"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

nate: That looks good. Two additions: enforce MFA for the assume-role call and log assume-role events to our audit stream.

elaine: How do we guarantee audit logs are immutable for the vendor window? Can we snapshot CloudTrail and ship a copy to secure S3 with Object Lock?

alex: Yes — create a dedicated bucket with Object Lock enabled, and an automated export of CloudTrail events for the window. Also add a parallel SIEM export to reduce single-point failure.

maria: Action items: 1) nate to prepare ephemeral role + MFA requirement (due in 48h). 2) elaine to provision CloudTrail export bucket with Object Lock and retention policy (due EOD Fri). 3) alex to add SIEM forwarder config and validate logs stream (due Fri).

nate: I'll draft the assume-role policy and test assume flow in staging. Ping me for creds handoff dry-run.

elaine: I'll set up the bucket and attach a lifecycle/retention note in the ticket. Planning a dry-run export Wed 10:00 PST.

alex: SIEM forwarder scheduled Wed 10:15 PST. Will post the verifier runbook in the thread once validated.

maria: On vulnerabilities: vendor will include medium/low findings. We want triage SLAs: P0/P1 within 72h, P2 within 7 days, others in backlog. Anyone object?

nate: fine by me. Also propose a retest slot 2 weeks after patching starts. Keep one contingency slot the week after.

elaine: Retest cadence sounds good. Add a regression smoke test list — storage, auth, and audit exports.

alex: I'll add automated gitlab jobs to run smoke tests post-remediation. Link to jobs when ready.

sre-bot: scheduled: pen-test dry-run export on 3532124000 (Wed 10:00 PST). Reminder will be posted 1h before.

maria: Perfect. Last item: communication channel for vendor queries — we'll use an ephemeral channel created the day before, invite vendor@supplier.com, and lock invites afterwards.

nate: I'll create the channel and preseed pinned messages: access window, point people, and emergency rollback steps.

elaine: One more ask — can we have KMS key rotation disabled for the day of evidence capture? Rotation might produce confusing key IDs for vendor.

alex: We'll schedule a key rotation hold via Ops for that date. Add it to the runbook.

maria: Great work team. I'll open the pen-test ticket with the action items and owners. Follow-ups in this thread please. :white_check_mark:
